[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:22:00) Ruth and I met at the county natural-history society in 2021 and discovered within about twenty minutes that we both preferred the stars to anything else on the programme. I remember we stayed out until 2am on a school night and neither of us could see the point of going in. It grew from there one person at a time. The specific tell is that she says she’d **“probably head direct”** and that her **supervision call until 6** means she’d **“barely make the food”** — so her actual preference/constraint was to skip the group meal.
